About me

I build practical AI software that solves real problems.

I’m Sharjeel Sarwar — a BSCS student and aspiring GenAI, Agentic AI and RAG developer. I learn by building: AI-powered solutions, agentic workflows, and web applications that integrate modern AI models with clean, usable interfaces.

My toolkit spans C++, C#, Python, SQL, AI APIs and web applications — and I pressure-test it in national and international AI and Generative AI hackathons, from AMD’s Developer AI Hackathon to the Pak Angels GenAI & Agentic AI Cohort 11, where I was named a Top Performer.
